elements.name: Vega
elements.features: Lean, average-height build; hair, facial hair, and eyes obscured, preventing further distinguishing details.

voice.instructions: Speak at a brisk but unhurried pace with warm confidence, light neutral American accent colouring, and an adult voice suggesting early 30s.
voice.why: A bright, warm voice gives Vega an approachable, energetic presence.
voice.sample_text: My name is Vega. Over Meridian Range, Vega’s F-35C and Rook’s F-35C race above blue ocean, gray wings spread, twin tails canted outward.

elements.name: Rook
elements.features: Average build; hair, facial hair, and eyes obscured by headgear.

voice.instructions: Speak at a measured pace with dry understatement, subtle British accent colouring, and a mature adult voice suggesting mid-40s.
voice.why: A low, restrained voice gives Rook a grounded presence that contrasts with Vega.
voice.sample_text: My name is Rook. Over Meridian Range, Vega’s F-35C and Rook’s F-35C race above blue ocean, gray wings spread, twin tails canted outward.

voice.instructions: Use a mature, low register with a calm documentary tone, measured pacing, clear articulation, unhurried pauses, and neutral accent colouring.
voice.descriptor: a calm documentary narrator for this film: measured, clear, unhurried
voice.why: Ash’s low, dry, measured delivery suits a calm documentary narrator.
voice.sample_text: Together, On Target. A short film from the record.

fixtures.detail: An isolated, weathered offshore platform raised above the sea on dark legs and cross-braced supports, with projecting decks, railings, a boxlike upper cabin, an overhanging roof and a narrow upright mast.
fixtures.name: Offshore platform

meridian-range.light: Natural daylight filtered through extensive blue-grey clouds; brighter pale light breaks through on the right, softly illuminating the sea and silhouetting much of the platform.
meridian-range.floor: No visible floor or land; rippling deep-blue seawater fills the foreground and middle distance, extending to a flat horizon.
meridian-range.walls: No enclosing walls; open sea and a broad, cloud-filled blue sky.

fixtures.detail: A dark angular instrument panel with several blue-black rectangular displays, rows of small bezel buttons, switches and knobs.
fixtures.name: Instrument panel

fixtures.detail: A black upright control grip with a rounded head and small coloured buttons, beside the lower instrument displays.
fixtures.name: Control stick

fixtures.detail: A tall black padded seat with a broad headrest, raised side supports and dark restraint straps across its lower section.
fixtures.name: Pilot seat

fixtures.detail: A clear curved canopy with a thick dark arched frame, showing blue sky and clouds through the glazing.
fixtures.name: Canopy and forward arch

fixtures.detail: Clear curved glazing extending above and behind the seat, with a dark lower rail and an angled rear frame at the far right.
fixtures.name: Rear canopy glazing and frame

fixtures.detail: A low black interior side panel beneath the canopy, with recessed sections and small fittings.
fixtures.name: Cockpit side console

fixtures.detail: A broad blue-grey painted cockpit rim and outer skin, with angular seams and a dark upper lip.
fixtures.name: Cockpit sill

vega-cockpit.light: Strong natural daylight through the clear canopy; cool blue sky reflections on the glazing and painted surfaces, bright highlights on the canopy arch, and deep shadows around the seat and controls.
vega-cockpit.floor: Not visible; concealed by the cockpit rim, instrument panel and seat.
vega-cockpit.walls: No conventional walls. The cockpit enclosure has dark charcoal and black metal or composite interior panels, blue-grey painted outer edges, and clear curved canopy glazing.

fixtures.detail: A large sloping grey housing with a dark, reflective rectangular screen and thick bevelled surround.
fixtures.name: Display console

fixtures.detail: A tall black padded seat back with a rounded rectangular headrest, stitched vertical seams and exposed metal supports.
fixtures.name: Cockpit seat

fixtures.detail: A curved dark instrument panel partly hidden by the seat, with round gauges, dark rectangular displays, small buttons and yellow-and-black warning markings.
fixtures.name: Instrument panel

fixtures.detail: A dark metal side rail with fasteners, recessed fittings and small printed information plates.
fixtures.name: Left cockpit sill

fixtures.detail: A dark metal side rail with recessed panels, fasteners and a small black information plate.
fixtures.name: Right cockpit sill

fixtures.detail: A partially visible black control panel with clustered knobs, switches and pale markings.
fixtures.name: Side control console

fixtures.detail: A short upright black grip with a rounded top, beside the central display housing.
fixtures.name: Control grip

fixtures.detail: Clear curved glazing enclosed by thick black outer framing and a thinner arch, with visible bolts and seals.
fixtures.name: Canopy and frame

rook-cockpit.light: Strong warm daylight enters through the clear canopy, especially from the right, producing golden highlights on the grey metal and black upholstery, reflections on the central screen and deep shadows inside the cockpit.
rook-cockpit.floor: Not visible; the central console and side fittings obscure the cockpit floor.
rook-cockpit.walls: Close-fitting dark charcoal and grey metal cockpit sidewalls with plain utilitarian panels, exposed fasteners, seams and small equipment labels; clear canopy glazing above.
